messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: elevated 5xx on model-runner-us-east-1 starting 03:12 UTC. error-rate 5xx > 8% over 2m window. alert group: infer-runtime-errors.

sam_oncall: acked — I'm on call. jumping in now. any initial customer impact?

alex_prod: seeing gateway 502/504 for /v1/generate. p95 latency +2.1s. two tenants (big-embed and search-one) showing >1% errors in last 5m.

maria_eng: pulling cores from affected pods. I see repeated SIGSEGV on quant attention kernel in logs. grabbing the most recent core.

deploy-bot: Restart failed on runner-45: container exit code 139. restart attempts: 3.

jen_sre: Short stack excerpt from runner-45 core dump:
```
#0 0x7f8a2c4a in quantized_attention_forward(...) at kernels/quant_attn.cu:421
#1 0x7f8a1b2c in run_attention at model/runner.cc:214
#2 0x55d3e8 in serve_request at serve/main.cc:1022
Segfault (SIGSEGV)
```

sam_oncall: thanks. sounds like a quant kernel regression. Maria — did we roll any quant changes recently?

maria_eng: yes — canary-quant-v2 rolled ~01:48 UTC to 30% traffic. temporal correlation looks strong. fetching rollout id and canary hosts.

maria_eng: mitigation plan: 1) throttle/rollback canary to 0% immediately, 2) drain affected runner hosts, 3) route traffic to quant-v1 fallback, 4) apply temporary rate-limit for embeddings-heavy endpoints.

sam_oncall: do it. prioritize rollback + draining. Alex, coordinate customer comms. Jen, monitor for new SIGSEGVs.

deploy-bot: Rollback job started: r-20260317-77. Target: canary-quant-v1.

alex_prod: draining runner-45 now. command I'm running:
```
./infra drain-runner --host runner-45 --grace 30s && ./infra restart-runner runner-45
```

kate_csm: pinging CS on impacted accounts (shopify-proto, corp-data) and posting interim note. will escalate if errors persist.

jen_sre: metrics update 60s after rollback: 5xx dropped from 8.7% -> 2.1%. p95 latency trending down. still monitoring for residual timeouts.

maria_eng: confirmed canary throttled to 0%. capturing rollout diff and saving cores to infra bucket: gs://prod-cores/3109871234/runner-45-core.gz

sam_oncall: good progress. keep an eye on the other runners in the same qpool — run a quick memory/eviction check.

alex_prod: running quick health check across pool: memory usage normal, no swaps. one host had high K/V cache growth; I'm limiting batch-size for that tenant as stopgap.

jen_sre: no fresh segfaults in last 3m. setting monitoring alert to notify if 5xx >1% for 5m.

sam_oncall: leaving thread for postmortem follow-up. if 5xx remains <1% for 30m we'll close. thanks all. :white_check_mark:

alex_prod: filing follow-up: infra#1234 - investigate bounds-check in quantized attention, add kvcache guard, improve canary rollback automation.

pagerduty-bot: Incident incident-3109871234 acknowledged by sam_oncall. Status: active -> monitoring.
